atlas_tasks.note: Atlas SCHEMA forbids overlay redeclaration of core templates.by_type.task (overlay_core_type). This overlay claims tasks/ and documents the task extension contract; skills enforce task_* / assignees / parent / sub_tasks / relates_to (dependency/blocks) fields on type:task pointer pages. task_id is the full atlas://<atlas_id>/tasks/<ULID> composite; pointer files live at tasks/<ULID>.md. Blocked is derived from kind:dependency edges, not a stored status. No depends_on field (v0.4.0). No kebab task_id / display_slug (v0.5.0 hard cut). Hierarchy (parent/sub_tasks) same-Atlas only; dependency/blocks may cross Atlases via atlas:// with fail-closed resolve. Hard cut at v0.3.0: no todo/ claim and no todo_id/todo_status read shim.
